rows.title: Copy of Newspaper Publication
rows.summary: The Company has informed the stock exchanges about the Copy of Newspaper advertisements dated 14th October, 2026 published in respect to the opening of Special Window in compliance with SEBI Circular dated the 30th January, 2026.
